request: What impact did passing Obamacare have on the federal budget?

reply.reply:
**At the time, CBO and JCT estimated that the ACA would reduce federal deficits by $210 billion over FY2012–FY2021, while its coverage expansion carried $1,390 billion in gross costs.**

- CBO and JCT estimated in their February 2011 baseline that ACA implementation would reduce federal deficits by $210 billion over FY2012-FY2021. (R41664, PDF p. 7)
- The ACA's insurance coverage expansion was estimated to have gross costs of $1,390 billion over FY2012-FY2021. (R41664, PDF p. 7)
- CBO and JCT projected ACA health-related revenue provisions would raise $391.7 billion over 10 years. (R41128, PDF p. 4)
reply.reasoning: The CRS overview reports the contemporaneous February 2011 CBO/JCT baseline estimate, including the estimated deficit reduction and gross coverage-expansion costs. A second CRS report separately provides context on expected ACA health-related revenues.
